neighbours.label: the token ' en' (also ' En'): French-style 'en route / en masse' and the word-start piece en- (en-shrine, En-field); not ' in' or ' on'
fire: The delegates walked out en masse when the vote was announced.
Each bedroom on the upper floor has an en suite bathroom.
The board resigned en bloc after the audit was published.
The fencing coach shouted en garde and the bout began.
She captured the pawn en passant on the fifth move.
The new charter will enshrine these rights for every citizen.
Years of illness had begun to enfeeble the old king.
He carried an old Enfield rifle that had belonged to his uncle.
quiet: The delegates walked out together when the vote was announced.
Each bedroom on the upper floor has a private bathroom.
The board resigned in protest after the audit was published.
The fencing coach shouted on guard and the bout began.
She captured the pawn in passing on the fifth move.
The new charter will protect these rights for every citizen.
Years of illness had begun to weaken the old king.
He carried an old Winchester rifle that had belonged to his uncle.

notes: Card: ' en' x14, ' in' x6, ' En' x4. Probes: 'en route' 0.82, 'en-liven' 0.53, 'En-quiries' 0.38, 'en español' 0.29; ' on the way' 0.17, 'in session' 0.01. Tokenisation of the test words checked.
